error_capital: Capital must be greater than zero.
error_risk: Risk percent must be between zero and one hundred.
error_same_price: The stop loss cannot equal the entry price.
hint: Derive size from the stop loss, not the other way round. Decide where the stop belongs first, then let the app tell you the size.
title: Position size calculator
warn_fees_significant: Fees are large relative to the amount risked. Even when right, this trade has a thin margin.
warn_high_leverage: Leverage above 10x. You are less than 10% away from liquidation.
warn_high_risk: Risking more than 2% of capital on one trade. Ten losses in a row do happen, and at this size they are hard to recover from.
warn_low_rr: Risk/reward below 1.5 — you would need to be right most of the time to stay profitable.
warn_margin_exceeds_capital: The required margin exceeds your capital. Raise leverage or widen the stop.
warn_near_liquidation: The stop is dangerously close to liquidation. One ordinary swing could close the position.
warn_stop_beyond_liquidation: Your stop sits beyond the liquidation price: the whole margin is gone before the stop is reached. Reduce leverage.
